# catalystcenter_qos_policy_setting (Resource)

Manages the global Application QoS policy setting. This is a singleton: the object always exists on the controller, so creating this resource updates the existing setting and destroying it only removes the resource from Terraform state without changing the controller.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "catalystcenter_qos_policy_setting" "example" {
  name                               = "qos_policy_setting"
  deploy_by_default_on_wired_devices = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deploy_by_default_on_wired_devices` (Boolean) Whether a QoS policy is deployed automatically to a wired network device when it is provisioned. Applies only where the device is assigned to a site that has a QoS policy configured.
- `name` (String) Fixed resource identifier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import catalystcenter_qos_policy_setting.example "<name>"
```
